_doc: Hand-curated half of the licence inventory (#805): what each top-level directory IS and which licence applies to it today, per-asset overrides, and Maven group licences that need no POM lookup. 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-licence-inventory.py refresh merges this with registry-resolved licences into licenses/inventory.json; check fails when the tree has a subject neither covers. LicenseRef-NoLicenseGranted = no licence file applies: all rights reserved by default. `proposed` is a proposal only - nothing is relicensed. Not legal advice.

com.google.mlkit.note: proprietary binary SDK under the ML Kit Terms of Service - not GPL-compatible if linked into a GPL app

com.google.ar.note: proprietary; Google APIs ToS + ARCore Additional Terms (see ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md)

a0_docs.proposed: PROPOSED (owner decides): CC-BY-NC-4.0 for prose, or keep all rights reserved

a_solutions.what: own Android tooling (termux-boot replacement, hooking engines, data exporter...) - README in ae-tool_termux-boot states it is not a termux-boot fork

aa_cloud-superapp.what: Cloud SuperApp launcher; links shared libs incl. GPL-3.0 libs:keyboard/libs:gitsync - see LICENSING.md conflicts

ab_cloud-libs-shared.what: shared libraries (libs/*), lib-apks and keyboard-engines; the upstream-derived libs are listed in licenses/upstreams.json and keep their upstream licence
ab_cloud-libs-shared.exceptions: libs/keyboard GPL-3.0-only; libs/gitsync GPL-3.0; libs/firewall/firestack MPL-2.0; libs/net, libs/net-wg, libs/cropper, libs/gesture, libs/panoramaviewer Apache-2.0; libs/calc native build pulls GPL-2.0-or-later libqalculate (see ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md); libs/contacts SocialImport.kt ported from Fossify Contacts (GPL-3.0)

ac_cloud-calc.what: Cloud Calc app; its engine APK (libs/calc) statically links GPL-2.0-or-later libqalculate and ships as GPL-3.0-or-later per ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md

ac_cloud-contacts.what: Cloud Contacts app (README: native, not a fork)

ac_cloud-keyboard.what: Cloud Keyboard app module; compiles libs/keyboard (HeliBoard-derived, GPL-3.0-only) so the APK is GPL-3.0-only

ac_cloud-myterminal.what: hub APK (own) + patch series for Amaze File Manager/Utilities (GPL-3.0) and Acode (MIT) in forks/; the patches carry their upstream licence

ac_cloud-notes.what: AFFiNE fork (MIT part; Enterprise dirs pruned and guarded by licence-guard.yml)

ac_cloud-office.what: Collabora Online patch series + own build engine; patches MPL-2.0, engine scripts own

ac_cloud-search.what: Cloud Search app; data-source terms in ac_cloud-search/NOTICE.md

licenses.proposed: PROPOSED (owner decides): CC0-1.0 for the data
